Add, edit, remove, order and tick an item's acceptance criteria

## Usage

```text
chainmail item criteria
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```

## Commands

- [chainmail item criteria add](./chainmail-item-criteria-add.md): Add criteria to the end of an item's list, in order
- [chainmail item criteria edit](./chainmail-item-criteria-edit.md): Change the text of one criterion
- [chainmail item criteria order](./chainmail-item-criteria-order.md): Put an item's criteria in a new order, naming every one once
- [chainmail item criteria remove](./chainmail-item-criteria-remove.md): Remove criteria from an item
- [chainmail item criteria tick](./chainmail-item-criteria-tick.md): Tick a criterion, with evidence that it is met
- [chainmail item criteria untick](./chainmail-item-criteria-untick.md): Untick a criterion and drop its evidence
